title: Double-slit fringes
caption: Bright fringes form where the path difference is a whole number of wavelengths, 1.2 mm apart on the screen. λ = d × fringe spacing / D = 0.5 mm × 1.2 mm / 1.0 m = 600 nm.
alt: Intensity across the screen: equally spaced bright peaks every 1.2 millimetres with dark minima halfway between.
description: Intensity on the screen against position, measured from the central bright fringe.
Bright fringes at 0, ±1.2, ±2.4 mm; dark fringes halfway, at ±0.6, ±1.8 mm.
Real fringes fade away from the centre because each slit also diffracts; that envelope is left out here.

checks.name: the next bright fringe is 1.2 mm from the centre
